# DEVSYNX

> DEVSYNX Private Limited is a software development company based in the Islamabad–Rawalpindi area of Pakistan (office: Old Airport Road, Chaklala Cantt., Rawalpindi). It builds custom software, web applications, iOS and Android apps, SaaS products, AI automation and AI voice agents, and provides SEO and digital marketing, for clients in Pakistan, the United States, the United Kingdom, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Canada, Australia and Europe.

## Key facts
- Legal name: DEVSYNX Private Limited (registered with the SECP, Pakistan)
- Office: Old Airport Road, Chaklala Cantt., Rawalpindi 46000, Pakistan (Islamabad–Rawalpindi). Phone and WhatsApp: +92 302 946 2542, answered 24/7. Clients in other cities and countries are served remotely, with on-site meetings by arrangement.
- Founder and CEO: Syed Hassan Ali Shah. Co-founder: Sana Fatima.
- Contact: info@devsynx.com, phone and WhatsApp +92 302 946 2542
- Working language: English (also Urdu)
- Engagement models: fixed-price projects paid by milestone, dedicated developers at a monthly rate, and dedicated teams
- Code ownership: clients receive full source code and IP ownership
- Public portfolio: 71 case studies at https://devsynx.com/clients/

## Services
- [Custom software development](https://devsynx.com/custom-software-development-company/): SaaS platforms, portals, CRM and ERP systems, integrations
- [MVP development](https://devsynx.com/mvp-development-company/): scoped MVPs, typically launched in about 30 days
- [Hire dedicated developers](https://devsynx.com/hire-dedicated-developers/): React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Flutter and AI engineers
- [AI automation agency](https://devsynx.com/ai-automation-agency/): AI voice agents, WhatsApp and web chatbots, workflow automation
- [Web development](https://devsynx.com/services/custom-web-development/): Next.js, WordPress and Shopify websites and web apps
- [Mobile app development](https://devsynx.com/app-development-company-pakistan/): Flutter and React Native apps for iOS and Android
- [SEO services](https://devsynx.com/services/seo-services/): technical, local and e-commerce SEO
- [All services](https://devsynx.com/services/)

## Selected case studies
- [Contractor Leads US](https://devsynx.com/clients/contractor-leads/): lead generation and CRM platform for contractors
- [DEVSYNX AI Voice Agent](https://devsynx.com/clients/ai-calling-agent/): AI calling agent for lead qualification and booking
- [ZeParty Live](https://devsynx.com/clients/zeparty/): live audio rooms app for Southeast Asia and the Middle East
- [Spicify App](https://devsynx.com/clients/spicify-app/): culinary and recipe social mobile app (US & UK)
- [QuickDoctor Ireland](https://devsynx.com/clients/quickdoctor-ie/): telehealth and prescription platform
- [RBO Accounting Services FZE](https://devsynx.com/clients/rbo-accounting/): corporate tax and accounting platform for a UAE firm
- [Top Performance Qatar](https://devsynx.com/clients/top-performance/): automotive performance parts e-commerce and booking in Qatar
- [Silayi Pret](https://devsynx.com/clients/silayi-pret/): Shopify e-commerce for a Pakistani fashion brand
